_about: DECISIONS HE MADE IN CHAT — the one hole the five swept sources cannot reach. A decision said in conversation and never written into a changelog, a standard or a workbook is in no file, so no sweep can find it. It is recorded HERE the same day, in his words, and the extractor folds it into the decision log beside the rest. This file is hand-written on purpose: it is the only place in the log that is.

rows.subject: When the Rent / Mortgage budget and the mortgage debt disagree
rows.means: The app tells the person the two figures disagree and asks them to correct it. Until they answer, the BUDGET figure is used — which is what the emergency fund already does.
rows.proof: src/__tests__/decisions_are_held.test.ts — DEC-0471: both figures and the gap are reported where they disagree; the BUDGET figure still drives the arithmetic; nothing is reported when they agree or when one is missing
rows.plain:
“Yes, ask User to correct, if not input from user, use the budget.” A mortgage can be entered twice — as the Rent / Mortgage budget line and as a Mortgage debt — and until now the app silently took the budget figure and said nothing. Two decisions:
1. Where the two disagree, the app SAYS SO and asks the person to correct it.
2. Until they answer, the BUDGET figure is the one used — so nothing changes in the arithmetic, only in what the person is told.
